name: elohim_horseman
description: an Elohim Horseman, a light cavalryman in a white hood over a round steel helmet, steel shoulder plates and mail under a pale blue and white tabard, a brown leather belt, a round blue-and-white shield with a steel boss on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped spear with a brown wooden shaft in his LEFT hand, riding a chestnut horse with a white blaze, a darker brown mane and tail and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round blue-and-white shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
